notes: joint semantics: a 17-row non-standard-form candidate requires the SAME rows t to pass ALL moduli under one fixed integer (a,u); the correct quantity is |intersect_m Pass_m(a,u)|, not min_m count_m (per-law pass sets differ). Single-law classMax < 17 (K0797) is the special case of a one-modulus certificate.

p-chain lemma: v in QR(p^k) implies v in QR(p^j) for j<k, so the 33-law list reduces losslessly to 34 coprime maximal prime powers; K0797's laws 5,7,8,9,11,13,16,17,25,27,32,49,64,81 are redundant given 125,343,128,243,121,169,289.

(a,u)=(0,0) passes all rows of every 1-mod-4 prime modulus (since -36 = -(6t)^2/t^2 pattern and -1 in QR); joint extinction is therefore driven by the 3-mod-4 moduli {19,23,29,31,...} and 7,3,11,13,17,2-power composites.

false-kill guard: K0797's own failure witness (a,u)=(0,1) mod 31 with 17 surviving rows at s=29 was reproduced (17), confirming the single-law analysis was measuring real survival, and the joint certificate kills it under law 23.
